title: Context operations to architecture modelling output from large language models and evaluation criteria for their use in systems engineering design
summary: The development of generative artificial intelligence resources enables opportunities of speeding up systems and engineering design work. This contribution introduces a framework of formal operations for assembling context in LLM-based engineering design. This framework involves the assembly of modular context units, including policy prompts, reference units with persistence, and user questions with prompt vectoring.
body: The development of generative artificial intelligence resources enables opportunities of speeding up systems and engineering design work. This contribution introduces a framework of formal operations for assembling context in LLM-based engineering design. This framework involves the assembly of modular context units, including policy prompts, reference units with persistence, and user questions with prompt vectoring. This approach enables the systematic structuring of interactions with generative models. A formal method for evaluating modelling-as-code LLM outputs is also presented, which enables the evaluation of compliance to intent from LLM answers and thereby asses the support from LLMs for systems architecture modelling.
summaryZh: 本文提出了一种用于系统工程设计中大模型上下文操作的形式化框架，涵盖了策略提示、参考单元及用户问题向量化等模块。同时，作者定义了一套评估方法，用于衡量大模型输出在系统架构建模中的合规性与意图匹配度，旨在提升生成式AI在工程设计领域的应用规范性。
